patches_submitted.subject: [PATCH 00/10] treewide: switch to __nonnull_args() macro
patches_submitted.patch_summary: This patch series replaces open-coded uses of the __attribute__((nonnull)) macro with the __nonnull_args() macro, which is a wrapper that keeps the quirks of the attribute in one place. The goal is to standardize nonnull attribute usage across the Linux kernel tree. The patches can be applied separately and are build-tested on various configurations. Some instances of __attribute__((nonnull)) remain in the tools subdirectory and should be updated separately after this patchset lands.

This change is preparatory and does not yet address the main patchset.

-__attribute__((nonnull(2,3)))
+__nonnull_args(2, 3)

  * to chaining of merge() calls: null-terminated, no reserved or

@@ -175,7 +175,7 @@ static void merge_final(void *priv, list_cmp_func_t cmp, struct list_head *head,
  * of size 2^k varies from 2^(k-1) (cases 3 and 5 when x == 0) to

  */

+__nonnull_args(2, 3)
 void list_sort(void *priv, struct list_head *head, list_cmp_func_t cmp)

 	struct list_head *list = head->next, *pending = NULL;

review_comments.summary: The author addressed a concern about the tools subdirectory not having the __nonnull_args() macro defined, which was causing test builds to break. They added a definition for the macro in tools/include/linux/compiler.h.
review_comments.raw_body:
Commit 22302af28d3f ("cleanup: Annotate guard constructors with
nonnull") added the macro __nonnull_args() to wrap raw compiler
attribute.

Replace __attribute__((nonnull)) with __nonnull_args() to standardize
nonnull attribute usage across the tree and keep the attribute's quirks
in one place rather than open-coded at every call site.

tools/testing/shared/linux/xarray.h directly includes the kernel's
include/linux/xarray.h, which now uses __nonnull_args(). The macro is
not defined under tools/, breaking test builds.

Define __nonnull_args() in tools/include/linux/compiler.h.

Suggested-by: Miguel Ojeda <miguel.ojeda.sandonis@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com>
---
 include/linux/xarray.h         | 4 ++--
 tools/include/linux/compiler.h | 4 ++++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/include/linux/xarray.h b/include/linux/xarray.h
index be850174e802..cf7f8802da5b 100644
--- a/include/linux/xarray.h
+++ b/include/linux/xarray.h
@@ -361,9 +361,9 @@ bool xa_get_mark(struct xarray *, unsigned long index, xa_mark_t);
 void xa_set_mark(struct xarray *, unsigned long index, xa_mark_t);
 void xa_clear_mark(struct xarray *, unsigned long index, xa_mark_t);
 void *xa_find(struct xarray *xa, unsigned long *index,
-		unsigned long max, xa_mark_t) __attribute__((nonnull(2)));
+		unsigned long max, xa_mark_t) __nonnull_args(2);
 void *xa_find_after(struct xarray *xa, unsigned long *index,
-		unsigned long max, xa_mark_t) __attribute__((nonnull(2)));
+		unsigned long max, xa_mark_t) __nonnull_args(2);
 unsigned int xa_extract(struct xarray *, void **dst, unsigned long start,
 		unsigned long max, unsigned int n, xa_mark_t);
 void xa_destroy(struct xarray *);
diff --git a/tools/include/linux/compiler.h b/tools/include/linux/compiler.h
index 03ecf9086643..fad2c6131a80 100644
--- a/tools/include/linux/compiler.h
+++ b/tools/include/linux/compiler.h
@@ -68,6 +68,10 @@
 #define __naked __attribute__((__naked__))
 #endif
 
+#ifndef __nonnull_args
+#define __nonnull_args(x...) __attribute__((__nonnull__(x)))
+#endif
+
 /* Are two types/vars the same type (ignoring qualifiers)? */
 #ifndef __same_type
 # define __same_type(a, b) __builtin_types_compatible_p(typeof(a), typeof(b))
